findings.fix: Zinc, used with Niacinamide, for oily, acne-prone skin
findings.why: A body-process claim (sebum activity) sits in the structure/function grey area. The 'helps regulate oiliness' wording on Matmarine is milder but the same concern. Legal should confirm.

language_read: 10% is stated in the standard format and the actives are named precisely. Sebum wording follows the page but is unhedged for Zinc.
tone_read: Ingredient-and-concentration-led, calm, with no fear or hype. It sounds like Minimalist.
